Name: Dmitry Ivanovich Petrov

Work Experience:
- 2022--Present: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Yandex Research. Led the design and deployment of scalable transformer-based models for real-time recommendation systems, improving click-through rate by 11%. Collaborated with a team of researchers to optimize distributed training efficiency using PyTorch Lightning and NVIDIA Triton. Designed model compression pipelines, including quantization-aware training, to deploy large models on mobile devices. Contributed to open-source LLM evaluation frameworks and internal benchmarking tools. Mentored junior engineers and co-led a cross-departmental initiative to integrate ML monitoring dashboards using Prometheus and Grafana.
- 2018--2022: Machine Learning Engineer, Sber AI Lab. Developed and maintained natural language processing models for financial document classification and named entity reco
